ValidationRule.description: High declared values must be consistent with the weight (value per kg bounded by sqrt of weight) and require Signature Required handling.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Declared_Value__c)), NULLVALUE(Weight_Kg__c, 0) > 0, OR( Declared_Value__c / Weight_Kg__c > 1000 * SQRT(Weight_Kg__c), AND(Declared_Value__c >= 5000, NOT(INCLUDES(Handling__c, 'Signature Required'))) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Declared Value is too high for the weight or lacks signature handling.
